newsitem.title: USA: Technitrol Inc Q1 sales, net, shr rise.
newsitem.headline: Technitrol Inc Q1 sales, net, shr rise.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: 1996 amounts adjusted for two-for-one split. Figures include net income from the Test and Measurement Products Segment, treated as a discontinued operation in view of its pending sale, which affected Q1 1997 by $0.02 a share and which affected Q1 1996 by $0.01 a share.
Figures also include an after-tax gain of $0.04 a share on the sale of Technitrol's Products Division in the first quarter of 1996.
Excluding these items, earnings in Q1 1997 were $0.40 a share, and earnings in Q1 1996 were $0.29 a share.
